## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (`feature/...` branch)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix/...` branch)
- [ ] Documentation or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/{description}` or `fix/{description}`
- [ ] Pull request title is a conventional commit (for example `feat: add password generator`)
- [ ] Solution builds and `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] No secret values, keys or decrypted content are logged
- [ ] Docs and `docs/PROGRESS.md` updated where relevant
